observations.title: Two-way M3 direct message across clients
steps: Guarded clock 01:00:00Z→01:01:00Z (no pending jobs/crossed boundaries/table change) to allow normal Web A OTP resend; normal OTP sign-in.
native181: H Inbox → QA Final Applicant chat shows A M3 message and M1 history; explicit Send of reply; no Retry.
Web A Inbox chat shows H reply at 02:01 London.

observations.title: Withdraw clears both consents; history read-only on both clients
steps: Web A Withdraw connection → confirmation sheet (messages stop, history kept, both must re-choose) → confirm → toast “Connection withdrawn. Private messages are now read-only.”
DB: A and H epoch3 consents revoked at 01:01, pair consent_epoch 4; messages count unchanged.
Web chat shows read-only notice and no composer; native182 cold launch shows history and no Message field.

observations.title: Block rejects reconnect on both clients without writes
steps: Web A H profile (via chat avatar) → Block → Block member → “You have blocked this member. Private contact is disabled.” DB block A→H active v1.
Web A post-meal reconnect tick → PUT reconnect 403, “This action isn’t available to you right now.”, no consent row.
native183 H DM read-only; its reconnect attempt is discarded as evidence because H write-burst count exceeded 10 in the frozen 1-second window (possible 429).
Guarded clock 01:01→01:02Z; native184 with only 2 H writes: reconnect rejected, no consent row, but generic error text (QA-F59).

observations.title: Block entry and unblock path defects
steps: native182: after the meal H has no control leading to A profile (meal detail, chat, post-meal) → cannot block (QA-F58). Probe failed at that step; read-only portion passed.
Web reload of H profile no longer shows blocked status/Unblock; re-block 409 leaves no Unblock (QA-F60). Unblock-does-not-revive not executed.
